title: How is ammonia dissociation measured and controlled in a nitriding furnace?
summary: Temperature records describe the heating conditions; atmosphere measurements support adjustment of ammonia dissociation inside the furnace. Neither replaces the other. A pit nitriding furnace proposal from Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd., signed 11 January 2020, proposed programmed control of temperature and ammonia dissociation using thermocouple and hydrogen-analysis signals respectively. Buyers should specify the measured variables, control actuators and final workpiece inspections separately.
